description: Ordinary UFO lifecycle traces and associated mission-site UFO release rows with pinned C++ transition methods and bounded mission fragments; controlled successful radar collaborator and asset-free region. GUI, pursuit, combat, scripts, retaliation and scheduling excluded. Ordinary traces record every five-second state; site rows isolate timer retention and objective score filtering. Transition rows cover all objective/operation combinations, linked and absent operation bases, and three non-terminal waypoints with objective flags disabled; aggressive retaliation is excluded. Normal lift rows cover all objective and operation combinations, including Base/Infiltration score suppression. Ordinary spawn rows cover all three objective-flag combinations without mission-site targeting.

buildOptions.sources: AlienMission.cpp think/spawnUfo ordinary fragments, ufoReachedWaypoint with unsupported bodies aborting, ufoLifting/isOver/getWaypoint/getLandPoint and addScore infiltration filter; GeoscapeState.cpp processMissionSite associated-UFO release block; Ufo.cpp think/setAltitude/isCrashed/isDestroyed/calculateSpeed; Target/MovingTarget/RuleRegion geometry. Driver controls time and radar success; see probe exclusions.
